name: Text Tools
description: Text processing utilities: Base64, UUID, hash (MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256), case conversion, character count, and text reversal.

slashCommands.title: Base64 Encode/Decode
slashCommands.description: Encode or decode text in Base64 format. Copies result to clipboard.

slashCommands.title: Generate UUID
slashCommands.description: Generate a random UUID v4 and copy to clipboard.

slashCommands.title: Compute Hash
slashCommands.description: Compute MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256 hash of text. Copies result to clipboard.

slashCommands.title: Case Conversion
slashCommands.description: Convert text to UPPERCASE or lowercase. Copies result to clipboard.

slashCommands.title: Count Text
slashCommands.description: Count lines, words, and characters in text.

slashCommands.title: Reverse Text
slashCommands.description: Reverse the input text. Copies result to clipboard.

slashCommands.title: Format / Minify JSON
slashCommands.description: Format or minify JSON text. Copies result to clipboard.

slashCommands.title: URL Encode / Decode
slashCommands.description: URL encode or decode text. Copies result to clipboard.
